LanguageData.LotRM_GondorApparel_Crown.label: Gondorian crown
LanguageData.LotRM_GondorApparel_Crown.description: The crown of Elendil, a ceremonial winged crown of the King of Gondor. It awaits the rightful heir to receive it.
An impressive helmet worn by the brave and loyal guards that protected the citadel of Minas Tirith.
LanguageData.LotRM_GondorApparel_PlateHelmet.label: Gondor plate helmet
LanguageData.LotRM_GondorApparel_PlateHelmet.descript: A helmet worn by soldiers from Gondor.
LanguageData.LotRM_GondorApparel_SwanKnightHelmet.des: The renowned Swan Knights of Dol Amroth serve as impressive cavalry in service of the kingdom of Gondor. Their helmet reflects their symbol - the swan.
